items.quote: If you’re making a public integration with Netlify for others to enjoy, you must use OAuth2.
items.why: States OAuth2 required for public integrations; no bearer_token or method list.
Shows Bearer header format only; no statement it's for own account/team use.
Marketing slogan about free hosting; nothing on sign-up, tokens, or OAuth apps.
Says Netlify uses OAuth2 for auth; nothing on API breadth or endpoints.
